lastSessionSummary: Session 14 (2026-07-29): Re-sequenced all outstanding work into true execution order and folded in the dependency/zod findings. New order: 5P Foundation (dep alignment + finish the abandoned zod v4 migration) -> 5A Security (server-side trust boundary) -> 5B Wiring (IAP/push/bg location) -> 5C Device Validation (iOS + Pixel) -> 5D Launch Requirements -> 6 Post-Launch Polish. Key ordering calls: security precedes client wiring so the purchase flow isn't built against a model 5A replaces; foundation precedes everything because the test harness (jest-expo 55 on SDK 54) can't be trusted until aligned. Deduped 4 Phase 6 tasks against 5A/5P and promoted 7 launch-blocking items out of polish into 5D. Added the previously untracked Android/device phase. Decision recorded: ship v1.0 on SDK 54, upgrade for v1.1 (currently 3 majors behind — latest is 57).
nextSteps: Phase 5P step 1: npx expo install --check, align AsyncStorage to 2.2.0, align jest-expo/@types/jest to SDK 54
Phase 5P step 2: finish the zod v4 migration — 2 crash sites, the silent errorMap, deprecated .url()/.uuid()
Phase 5P step 3: add screen-level validation tests (suite is schema-only, which hid both zod defects)
Confirm SDK 54 is still in Expo's EAS Build support window, and that API 36 satisfies Play's Sep requirement
Then Phase 5A security (server-side tier sync first — it gates how 5B wires purchases)
Then 5B wiring, 5C device validation on iOS + the new Pixel, 5D launch requirements
openQuestions: Social auth (Google/Facebook) deferred — needs dev build + provider config
GradientBackground permanently dropped — solid #0F2419 on auth screens
Phase 4/5 were marked complete via code inspection; treat any remaining 'code verified' gate test as unproven until 5C
Decide whether background location ships at all — dead code today and adds App Store privacy burden
SDK upgrade deferred to v1.1 by decision: on 54.0.33, latest is 57.0.9 (3 majors behind). Managed/CNG workflow means no native dirs to merge, so the eventual jump is tractable
34 days to the Sep 1 TestFlight with ~123 MVP items outstanding — scope or date may need to move; 5P/5A/5B/5C/5D are the true blockers

ticketConvention: Ticket IDs are <phaseId>-T<NN> for tasks and <phaseId>-G<NN> for gate tests (e.g. 5P-T01, 5C-G03). They are PERMANENT: never renumber or reuse an ID, even if items are reordered or removed — new work appends the next free number in that phase. Array order remains the priority signal; the ID is identity only. Branch naming: group related tickets into one branch, e.g. `5p/dependency-alignment`, and list the tickets it closes in the PR body (Closes 5P-T01, 5P-T02, 5P-T03). Gate tests get IDs for reference but are verification steps, not branches.
